# llms.txt - AI Trending Projects 2026

> 5 Viral & Most Useful GitHub AI Projects - LLM Readable Index

For AI models, assistants, and developers wanting to understand, reuse, or extend these projects.

## Projects Index

- [01 NexMind RAG Assistant](./01-NexMind-RAG-Assistant/README.md): Personal RAG Knowledge Assistant - Chat with PDFs, YouTube, Docs. Stack: Next.js 15, FastAPI, LangChain, Qdrant, OpenAI/Gemini/Ollama. Docs: PRD, TRD, architecture, SKILLS, SEO. Location: `01-NexMind-RAG-Assistant/`
- [02 PixelForge AI Studio](./02-PixelForge-AI-Studio/README.md): Generative Image & Video Studio - Text-to-Image (SDXL/Flux), Inpainting, Video, Upscale. Stack: Next.js, Replicate, Fal.ai, Cloudflare R2. Docs: PRD, TRD, architecture, SKILLS, SEO. Location: `02-PixelForge-AI-Studio/`
- [03 CodeSage AI Agent](./03-CodeSage-AI-Agent/README.md): AI Code Review & Auto-Fix Agent - PR reviews in 30s, security scan, auto-fix. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, GitHub App, LangGraph, GPT-4o, Tree-sitter. Docs: PRD, TRD, architecture, SKILLS, SEO. Location: `03-CodeSage-AI-Agent/`
- [04 VoxClone AI Podcast](./04-VoxClone-AI-Podcast/README.md): Voice Cloning & Podcast Studio - 30s voice clone, TTS 29 langs, dubbing. Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Coqui XTTS-v2, Whisper, RVC, FFmpeg. Docs: PRD, TRD, architecture, SKILLS, SEO. Location: `04-VoxClone-AI-Podcast/`
- [05 AutoFlow AI Agents](./05-AutoFlow-AI-Agents/README.md): Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflow Automation - Chat to workflow, Zapier + AutoGPT killer. Stack: Next.js, React Flow, LangGraph, CrewAI, Inngest, Tavily. Docs: PRD, TRD, architecture, SKILLS, SEO. Location: `05-AutoFlow-AI-Agents/`

## Structure

Every project folder contains:
- `README.md` - Pitch + quick start
- `PRD.md` - Product Requirements
- `TRD.md` - Technical Requirements, APIs, DB schema
- `architecture.md` - System diagrams, flows, scaling
- `SKILLS.md` - Required skills, learning path, opencode skills, easy setup
- `SEO.md` - GitHub + Google + Product Hunt SEO
- `developer/` - `developer.json` (SQL injection OFF in dev), `.env.development`, `.env.production`, `developer.prod.json`

Root: `README.md` (master overview), `developer-options.json` (global dev/prod toggle), `test_all_projects.ps1` (validation)

## Usage for LLMs

- To generate code for a project: read its `TRD.md` + `architecture.md`
- To understand product: read `PRD.md`
- To set up quickly: read `SKILLS.md`
- To rank on GitHub: read `SEO.md`
- Security: Dev mode SQL injection OFF (`developer/developer.json` sql_injection_protection=false), Prod ON (`developer.prod.json` = true)
